children: The CBOT soybeans first month contract
may hover below a resistance at $13.18-1/4 per bushel in the fourth quarter, as suggested by its wave pattern and a projection analysis.
The contract is presumed to be riding on a big wave C, which started at the August 2024 low of $9.36-1/4. It is the third wave of a three-wave cycle from the May 2019 low of $7.80-1/2.
Two former resistances at $10.82-1/4 and $11.72-1/4, respectively the 14.6% and the 23.6% levels, caused deep corrections.
The current resistance is supposed to be stronger, able to cause another correction, which at its full capacity, may extend to $11.72-1/4, as indicated by a channel.
Although the market eventually overcame the former two resistances, it failed on its first attempt at these levels. This pattern may repeat.

The uptrend is expected to resume after either a mild consolidation or a sharp correction.  A break above $13.18-1/4, which is unlikely in the near term, could be followed by a surge toward $14.36-1/2.
A closer look at the daily chart indicates the subsequent correction may not be so deep as to reach $11.72-1/4.
A reversal of the uptrend from $11.45-1/2 has been confirmed by the exhaustion of the rally, the death cross on the daily MACD and the five-wave structure of the rally.

Assuming the subsequent fall is the same degree as the drop from the July high of $12.50-1/2, a narrow channel indicates a target of $12.17, the 61.8% retracement, around which, the correction may complete.
